subject: organic
question: 有机化学·Reaction Learn 命名反应学习卡：请用文字概述该反应的主要转化：Woodward cis-hydroxylation。 来源卡片给出的代表性条件：I₂, AgOAc, AcOH/H₂O, heat；KOH, MeOH。
answer: Iodine and silver acetate in wet acetic acid give the syn diol: water opens the cyclic acetoxonium ion to an orthoester, which collapses to a monoacetate.
explanation: 来源补充说明（未专家审核）：Iodine attacks the less hindered face and the oxygens end up on the other face, so in rigid molecules (steroids) the cis diol forms on the face opposite to the one OsO₄ attacks. Here cis-stilbene gives the meso diol.
